## Overview

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **Family / class** | Dynamic pool models → Equilibrium per-recruit |
| **Method name** | YPR / SPR / Thompson & Bell |
| **Short description** | Equilibrium yield- and spawning-biomass-per-recruit analysis from growth, natural mortality, maturity and selectivity, giving F-based reference points. |
| **Main outputs** | YPR, SPR, proxy reference points |
| **Typical use case** | Age-based |

::: {.callout-tip}

## Use and misuse {#use-and-misuse}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
method_warnings("ypr")
```

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **Pre-run checks** | Is the weight-at-age (or length) sample representative of the full population, with all age groups sampled? Is natural mortality estimated from several methods (e.g. the Stock Monitoring Tool natural mortality estimators) rather than a single value? (after Gutierrez and Kleisner, 2018) |
| **Do not use when** | [To be completed]{.todo} <br><small>Lists data situations or configurations under which the method should not be applied.</small> |
| **Common misuses** | [To be completed]{.todo} <br><small>Describes frequent ways the method is applied incorrectly and their consequences.</small> |
| **Pre-use checklist** | [To be completed]{.todo} <br><small>Minimum checks to pass before results are used for advice.</small> |
| **Advice suitability** | F-based reference points (F~max~, F~0.1~, F~SPR%~); F~0.1~ is more precautionary than F~max~. |
